title: Use outputs with care
summary: Before sharing generated work, review facts, privacy, permissions and suitability. Keep a person responsible for the final choice.
introduction: Before sharing generated work, review facts, privacy, permissions and suitability. Keep a person responsible for the final choice. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Before sharing generated work, review facts, privacy, permissions and suitability. Keep a person responsible for the final choice.

blocks.code:
Before sharing a poster:
Check names and dates
Use permitted source material
Remove private details
Read all visible text
Say how AI helped when that context matters
blocks.title: Use outputs with care

blocks.text: The checklist connects review to a specific poster. It does not replace the publisher's rules or the rights of source creators.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name one detail a generated school poster must get right.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A tool allowing a download does not settle every reuse right or factual question.
For more detail later, use this [Generative AI further reading](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/intro-to-ml/what-is-ml).
